title: Northgate Credit Cards Product Change Map
content:
When the membership linked to a Northgate Credit Cards account changes tier, the account may move to another card product. This map gives, for each card product, the product the account moves to (or none), whether the card number and history are kept, and from when the new product's rates apply.

## Map

| Card product held | Product the account moves to when the linked membership changes tier | Card number and history kept | New product's rates apply from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | None | Yes | The first statement after the change |
| Northgate Business Store Card | None | Yes | The first statement after the change |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | Yes | The first statement after the change |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | Yes | The first statement after the change |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | Yes | The first statement after the change |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | Northgate Rewards Visa Business | Yes | The first statement after the change |

## Reading the map

- **Pairs.** The Rewards Visa products form two reciprocal pairs: Northgate Rewards Visa Signature and Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus move to each other, and Northgate Rewards Visa Business and Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus move to each other.
- **Store cards.** Neither the Northgate Store Card nor the Northgate Business Store Card has a product to move to.
- **Continuity.** On every product the card number and the account history are kept through a product change.
- **Rates.** Statements before the change keep the rates of the product held at the time; the new product's rates apply from the first statement after the change.
